issues.display_title: Issue #573: Enforce ACID Transaction Atomicity in HashtagPost
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Enforce ACID Transaction Atomicity in HashtagPost

  • Date: 2026-10-28
  • Status: Completed
  • Coverage: 100% PASS
  • Configuration: ZERO NEW ENV REQUIRED

1. Summary

Secured post hashtag mutations against partial failure and data loss:

  1. ACID Transaction Atomicity:

    • Wrapped tx.Where(...).Delete(&Models.Hashtag{}) and tx.Create(&hashtagsToInsert) in Config.DB.Transaction.
    • Guaranteed automatic rollback if insertion fails, preserving original hashtags.

  2. Pre-Flight Parsing & Minimal Lock Time:

    • Pre-parsed and structured hashtagsToInsert in-memory prior to entering the transaction.
    • Added Config.DB == nil check to prevent runtime panics.

  3. Automated Unit Testing:

    • Added unit test cases TestHashtagPost_Unauthorized and TestHashtagPost_NilDB in src/Action/V1/Hashtag/hashtag_helpers_test.go.

2. Files Modified & Created

  • Modified:
    • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/HashtagPost.go
    • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/hashtag_helpers_test.go
  • Created:
    • docs/tasks/2026-10-28/atomic_transaction_hashtag_post.md
    • docs/tasks/implementations/2026-10-28/atomic_transaction_hashtag_post_impl.md

3. Verification

go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Hashtag/...
# PASS (100% tests passed)

go vet ./src/...
# PASS (0 warnings)

go build ./cmd/...
# PASS (0 errors)
  • Area: Hashtag / Database / Transactions / Data Integrity
  • Files Affected:
    • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/HashtagPost.go
    • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/hashtag_helpers_test.go
  • Date: 2026-10-28

1. Problem & Context

In src/Action/V1/Hashtag/HashtagPost.go, updating hashtags on a post executed two separate, non-transactional database operations:

  1. Deleting existing hashtags: Config.DB.Where(...).Delete(&Models.Hashtag{})
  2. Inserting new parsed hashtags: Config.DB.Create(&hashtagsToInsert)
    If the insertion step encountered a database error, network timeout, or constraint violation, the deletion of old hashtags had already been committed, causing permanent data loss (all hashtags previously associated with the post were lost).

2. Scope & Solution

  1. Atomic Database Transaction:
    • Wrapped the delete-and-insert sequence inside an atomic Config.DB.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error { ... }).
    • If inserting new hashtags fails, the deletion of old hashtags automatically rolls back, restoring original hashtags.
  2. Safe Pre-Flight Operations:
    • Pre-parsed and structured hashtagsToInsert in-memory before opening the database transaction, keeping database lock duration minimal.
    • Guarded against nil Config.DB.
  3. Zero Configuration & Zero Contract Changes:
    • No new environment variables added; responses and status codes remain 100% identical.
  4. Unit Testing:
    • Added TestHashtagPost_Unauthorized and TestHashtagPost_NilDB in hashtag_helpers_test.go.

3. Acceptance Criteria

  • Delete and insert operations for hashtags are fully atomic under Config.DB.Transaction.
  • Failed inserts roll back hashtag deletions cleanly.
  • 100% unit tests pass in src/Action/V1/Hashtag.
  • Clean build and vet checks.

issues.display_title: Issue #571: Haversine Great-Circle Distance Consolidation and Clamping Math Safety
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Haversine Great-Circle Distance Consolidation and Clamping Math Safety

  • Date: 2026-10-28
  • Status: Completed
  • Coverage: 100% PASS
  • Configuration: ZERO NEW ENV REQUIRED

1. Summary

Standardized spatial distance algorithms and clamping protections in panorra-api-go-new without dead code:

  1. Centralized Geospatial Module:

    • Created src/Utils/Functions/Haversine.go providing HaversineDistanceKM.
    • Clamped trigonometric variable a within [0.0, 1.0], guaranteeing that math.Sqrt(1-a) never operates on negative floats or produces NaN.

  2. Deduplication in LocationGrouping.go:

    • Refactored CalculateDistance to forward directly to Functions.HaversineDistanceKM.
    • Maintained 100% backwards compatibility for DecideGroup and all callers.

  3. Dead Code Elimination:

    • Excluded unused SQL expressions not present in panorra-api-go-new to keep the codebase lean.

  4. Automated Unit Testing:

    • Verified zero distance, known geographic distance, symmetry, and antipodal pole safety in src/Utils/Functions/Haversine_test.go.

2. Files Modified & Created

  • Modified:
    • src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/LocationGrouping.go
  • Created:
    • src/Utils/Functions/Haversine.go
    • src/Utils/Functions/Haversine_test.go
    • docs/tasks/2026-10-28/haversine_consolidation_and_clamping.md
    • docs/tasks/implementations/2026-10-28/haversine_consolidation_and_clamping_impl.md

3. Verification

go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/...
# PASS (100% tests passed)

go vet ./src/...
# PASS (0 warnings)

go build ./cmd/...
# PASS (0 errors)
  • Area: Geospatial / Algorithms / Math Safety / Code Consolidation
  • Files Affected:
    • src/Utils/Functions/Haversine.go
    • src/Utils/Functions/Haversine_test.go
    • src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/LocationGrouping.go
  • Date: 2026-10-28

1. Problem & Context

  1. Uncentralized Geospatial Calculations:
    • In LocationGrouping.go, great-circle distance was calculated using raw trigonometry formulas without centralizing the Earth radius constant (R = 6371.0 km).
  2. Floating-Point Clamping & NaN Vulnerability:
    • In standard Haversine calculations: c := 2 * math.Atan2(math.Sqrt(a), math.Sqrt(1-a)).
    • When coordinates are near-antipodal or have floating-point rounding precision drifts where a > 1.0, 1-a evaluates to a negative number, resulting in math.Sqrt(negative) returning NaN (Not a Number).
    • In LocationGrouping.go, any distance comparison NaN <= thresholdKm evaluates to false, silently breaking grouping logic.
  3. Dead Code Prevention:
    • While panorra-api-go uses SQL-level distance ordering (NearestPost.go, GetPlaceList.go), panorra-api-go-new processes spatial grouping strictly in-memory (LocationGrouping.go). Unused SQL expression generators are excluded to prevent dead code accumulation.

2. Scope & Solution

  1. Lean Centralized Geospatial Module (src/Utils/Functions/Haversine.go):
    • Implemented HaversineDistanceKM(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 float64) float64 with safe a = clamp(0.0, 1.0) domain protection.
    • Defined canonical EarthRadiusKM = 6371.0 (WGS-84 / IUGG standard).
  2. Refactored LocationGrouping.go:
    • Delegated CalculateDistance(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2) directly to Functions.HaversineDistanceKM.
    • Removed unused math import.
  3. Zero Configuration:
    • No new environment variables; pure standard library math functions.
  4. Unit Testing:
    • Added TestHaversineDistanceKM (verifying zero distance, known Jakarta-Bandung benchmark, symmetry, and antipodal pole-to-pole safety) in Haversine_test.go.

3. Acceptance Criteria

  • Great-circle distance calculations are unified in src/Utils/Functions/Haversine.go.
  • Floating-point domain errors and NaN values are prevented via safe clamping.
  • Zero dead/unused functions.
  • 100% unit tests pass cleanly in src/Utils/Functions/....
  • Clean build and vet checks.

issues.display_title: Issue #575: Comprehensive Panic Elimination on Slices and Nil Assertions in Cronjobs & Handlers
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Comprehensive Panic Elimination on Slices and Nil Assertions in Cronjobs & Handlers

  • Date: 2026-10-28
  • Status: Completed
  • Coverage: 100% PASS
  • Configuration: ZERO NEW ENV REQUIRED

1. Summary

Secured all cronjobs and helper handlers against out-of-bounds slice indexing and nil pointer panics:

  1. Hardened UpdateScoreTimeline.go:

    • Standardized followers, totalLikes, likes, comments, viewCount, currentFollowers, and id/userId/postId using Functions.StringValue, Functions.Int64Value, and Functions.Float64Value.
    • Prevented crashes from missing follower records, nil IDs, or empty Elasticsearch counters.
    • Handled dynamic parsing of score_updated_at (supporting both time.Time and RFC3339 string representations).

  2. Cronjob DB Nil Guards:

    • Added if Config.DB == nil { return nil } across UpdateScoreTimeline.go, CheckVerifiedEmail.go, and DeleteDraftPost.go.

  3. Slice Bounds Guards:

    • Guarded strings.Split(folders, "|") against len(folder) < 2 in DeleteUserContainers.go.
    • Guarded multiplePath[0] against empty slices in DeleteDraftPost.go.

  4. Handler Type Assertions:

    • Replaced raw string assertions in Notifications/helpers.go and DownloadUploadFileGDV1.go with Functions.StringValue.

  5. Automated Unit Testing:

    • Created src/Action/V1/Cronjob/cronjob_safety_test.go with nil-DB and nil-storage test suites.

2. Files Modified & Created

  • Modified:
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/UpdateScoreTimeline.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckVerifiedEmail.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/DeleteDraftPost.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/DeleteUserContainers.go
    • src/Action/V1/Notifications/helpers.go
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/DownloadUploadFileGDV1.go
  • Created:
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/cronjob_safety_test.go
    • docs/tasks/2026-10-28/eliminate_cronjob_and_handler_panics.md
    • docs/tasks/implementations/2026-10-28/eliminate_cronjob_and_handler_panics_impl.md

3. Verification

go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Cronjob/...
# PASS (100% tests passed)

go vet ./src/...
# PASS (0 warnings)

go build ./cmd/...
# PASS (0 errors)
  • Area: Cronjob / Notifications / Posts / Crash Prevention / High Availability
  • Files Affected:
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/UpdateScoreTimeline.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckVerifiedEmail.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/DeleteDraftPost.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/DeleteUserContainers.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/cronjob_safety_test.go
    • src/Action/V1/Notifications/helpers.go
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/DownloadUploadFileGDV1.go
  • Date: 2026-10-28

1. Problem & Context

Throughout several scheduled cronjobs and controller helpers, slice index accessing and raw type assertions were performed directly on unchecked query results:

  1. Out-of-Bounds & Raw Assertion Panics in UpdateScoreTimeline.go:
    • Accessing checkFollower[0]["total_followers"].(int64) panicked if checkFollower was empty.
    • Raw assertions scoreUpdate["post_id"].(string) and scoreUpdate["id"].(string) panicked on nil DB fields.
    • Unchecked unmarshaling postCountMap["counter_like"].(float64) panicked when counters were missing from Elasticsearch.
    • checkPost["score_updated_at"].(time.Time) panicked if the timestamp was stored as string or nil.
  2. Missing Nil DB Guards in CheckVerifiedEmail.go and DeleteDraftPost.go:
    • Calling Config.DB.Table(...) without nil check led to SIGSEGV panics when DB was reconnecting or uninitialized.
  3. Out-of-Bounds in DeleteDraftPost.go and DeleteUserContainers.go:
    • Directly accessing multiplePath[0] or folder[1] without checking slice bounds.
  4. Unchecked Map Type Assertions in Notifications/helpers.go and DownloadUploadFileGDV1.go:
    • checkUser[0]["id"].(string) and checkPost[0]["id"].(string).

2. Scope & Solution

  1. Safe Value Extractors:
    • Standardized on Functions.StringValue, Functions.Int64Value, and Functions.Float64Value to handle nil, string, int, and float conversions safely without panic.
  2. Database Nil Guards:
    • Added guards returning nil cleanly when Config.DB == nil in cronjob entrypoints (UpdateScoreTimeline, CheckVerifiedEmail, DeleteDraftPost).
  3. Safe Bounds & Timestamp Extraction:
    • Added len(folder) < 2 guard in DeleteUserContainers.go.
    • Added len(multiplePath) > 0 check in DeleteDraftPost.go.
    • Implemented dynamic type checking for score_updated_at (supporting both time.Time and string parsing).
  4. Automated Unit Testing:
    • Added TestUpdateScoreTimeline_NilDB_DoesNotPanic, TestDeleteDraftPost_NilMinio_DoesNotPanic, and TestCheckVerifiedEmail_NilDB_DoesNotPanic in cronjob_safety_test.go.

3. Acceptance Criteria

  • All slice access is safely bounded.
  • Nil DB and nil map fields do not trigger runtime panics.
  • 100% unit tests pass cleanly in src/Action/V1/Cronjob/....
  • Clean build and vet checks.
